title: Dispute/stake integration
purpose: Preserve verifier collateral through dispute finality and atomically hand independently adjudicated objective verifier-error evidence into the existing policy-bound slash authorization path.
requirements: opening a dispute under bound CMP-1.5.8 wiring freezes the canonical verifierId associated with the original verifier authority
address-cast verifier identity is not sufficient for CMP-1.5.8 objective stake evidence
active verifier disputes hold the verifier's collateral from withdrawal without themselves authorizing a slash
provider-win, withdrawn and timed-out cases release the dispute stake hold without creating slash authorization
generic adverse disputes do not remain a verifier slash hold merely because the payer won
a FINAL objective verifier-error disposition preserves the stake hold until a nonzero objective slash authorization is recorded
objective verifier-dispute evidence binds exact verifierId, verifier authority, immutable stakePolicyId and verification-policy tuple
nonfinal, timed-out, generic-ground, unresolved-appeal and non-independent-appeal cases fail closed as slash evidence
the integration hand-off calls the existing ComputeStakeSlashAuthorization420 path before acknowledging/releasing the dispute stake hold
if slash authorization reverts, the dispute stake hold remains pending atomically
verifier collateral withdrawal checks the dispute hold independently of the ordinary outstanding-slash hold
payer escrow, provider entitlement allocation and dispute economic resolution remain owned by the existing settlement layer
CMP-1.5.8 introduces no arbitrary governance slash, no Trust/reputation slash path and no beneficiary selection
security_boundaries: an allegation or active dispute is a withdrawal-preservation hold only, not objective misconduct proof
only the explicit objective verifier-error ground can remain pending for slash hand-off after FINAL disposition
stake evidence uses frozen canonical verifierId instead of reconstructing identity from an address after possible rotation
stake policy is immutable in the evidence adapter instance and rechecked by the frozen slash policy
slash authorization remains responsible for policy revision, code hash, subject, evidence, chronology, amount and replay checks
stake hold acknowledgement requires the bound integration controller and a nonzero authorization reference
existing dispute settlement remains noncustodial with respect to ComputeStake collateral

milestone.rationale: CMP-1.5.8 crosses the qualified dispute lifecycle, verifier identity, verifier collateral, objective slash evidence and slash authorization boundaries.

level_1_required: focused dispute/stake evidence, hand-off and withdrawal-hold tests
